fusions.name: Sic 'Em
fusions.desc: Lashes your tongue at one enemy up to 6 tiles away for 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 30%. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Pack Call
fusions.desc: A baying croak that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. If it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Licked Clean
fusions.desc: One pass of your tongue restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. The healing rises 1% for every 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Bog Pup
fusions.desc: A bonded bog pup fights beside you, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and slowing them 20% for 2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
